notes.title: New Game Mode: Shrunken Farmers!
notes.notes:
[h1]Shrunken Farmers![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28671720/fcc0d9d594688a472d75d4a8fb974ed7364c94ef.gif[/img]

You're a tiny farmer in a giant world! Fight across all the original maps in this new bit sizes game mode!

[h1]🎼 In-Game Music! 🎼[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28671720/50123a501ae679342536d9fa6d6bcf1473c2d3d0.gif[/img]

You can now play any of the lobby tracks you have unlocked DURING MATCHES! Find all your music in the taunt wheel where you can select what you’d like to jam out to!
(A new setting has been added to show or hide the current song in your HUD)

[h1]🛠️ Fixes 🛠️[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed Galactic Groove always unlocked even if you didn't play Season 3
[*] Fixed players spinning around when using view finder. 
[*] Fixed burning bone head hat fire glitching when you look around
[*] PS4 controller icons should now correctly show when on PC
[*] Skyhook items should once again be unlocking correctly
[*] Fixed item alerts not showing properly when you prestige
[*] Pistol should no longer show in the shotgun animation pose in certain situations
[*] Bok n Roll logo on the stageside lobby should now no longer clip through the wall
[*] Endless mode should now work correctly past wave 31 on northside
[/list]

Thank you to the community for finding and reporting these bugs!

See you on the tiny farm!
-Qazi

notes.title: 🍅 New Update! Patch 1.6.4 🍅
notes.notes:
Update 1.6.4 is here! 🎉

The biggest new addition is Room Codes! Easily join your friends' matches no matter what platform they're on by entering the 4 letter room code they are in. You can find the room code in the scoreboard at any time.

Streaming the game? Hide your room code with the new Streamer Mode and Private Matches! And yes, the Gromato Launcher has been nerfed a tiny bit.

[h2]👍 Changes 👍[/h2]
Overtime and Sudden Death now have a 2 minute time limit, and will otherwise end in a draw.
Rooms now have a Room Code you can share with friends to join your room.
Rooms can now be set as Private, allowing you to kick players and prevent random people from joining. Use the Room Code to have your players join.
New Streamer Mode setting in Options menu masks player names and hides the Room Code.
Player skins no longer swap between blue and red.
Zombies now have spawn animations coming out of the ground.
New Lemonade and Crop Drop sound effects.
Gun Cursor now animates to be tighter when you’re aiming.
The Randomize button in the Customize menu will randomize your shovel and badge.
Kills, Deaths, Assists, Zombie Kills, and weapon kills are now saved when you exit a match or horde mode without finishing.
Matches wait to start until all players have joined to fix countdown desync issues.
Decrease Gromato Launcher plant growth to be 60% slower.
Fixed Gromato hitbox requiring more accurate hits on players.
Updated Japanese localization.

[h2]🛠 Fixes 🛠 [/h2]
Fixed muzzle flashes sometimes not showing.
Fixed players spawning on top of each other in Victory screen.
Fixed crash due to Gromato Audio Sources.
Fixed players having floating white names when you join a match that has just ended.
Fixed some player skins having a floating head when in camo.
Fixed Diamond Body missing.
Fixed player names missing in Social tab during a match
Fixed controller & mouse sensitivity settings not working when taunting or riding pig.

[h2]🛠 Fixes Xbox 🛠 [/h2]
Fixed joining password protected rooms not working

Thank you for all your support! Get your hat and gloves ready for the Winter Event coming up next!

-Qazi

notes.title: 🐔🎈 Crop Drop Update 🎈🐔
notes.notes:
[h2]🎈 New Feature: The Crop Drop 🎈[/h2]
Up in the air! It’s a bird! It’s a plane! No wait, that’s just a Crop Drop.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28671720/68c3009c952b295c428364d044f7ba68caa761f4.gif[/img]

Keep an eye on the skies for new supply drops filled with randomized guns, grenades, and even special weapons you won’t find anywhere else! Crop Drops will spawn around the map every 2 minutes during a match and every 4 minutes during Horde Mode.

[h2]🌽🌽 New Weapon: The Double Cob 🌽🌽[/h2]
We can’t call this game ‘Shotgun Farmers’ without having a double barrel shotgun! Say hello to The Double Cob:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28671720/027ea2f0dc246e030bd3ad31a0e18521f16b842e.gif[/img]

Fire twice in quick succession without having to pump. Reload your Double Cob with ANY, that’s right, ANY normal Shotgun plant. Only caveat though, it can only grow regular Shotgun plants!

You’ll only find the Double Cob in some Crop Drops during the match. Look out for that 🐔🎈!

[h2]💎 Diamond Farmer Outfit 💎[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28671720/cd8c6446413c8cf30e10d2afa50e0597ab8abc41.gif[/img]

Reach Prestige Rank 3 to unlock the full diamond body!

[h2]🐻 z0mbear Head 🧟‍♂️[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28671720/9480a880ea54862d10f98dcaa8f0aa0b738c0994.gif[/img]

z0mbear has been an awesome influencer, championing Shotgun Farmers on Twitch and Tiktok. To celebrate him, you can unlock the z0mbear head in-game using code 'z0mbear'

[h2]🦈Skyhook Badges 🐱[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28671720/5d43ef8bbbbcb31f73739262abdbb35592145ac4.png[/img]

If you play my first game, Skyhook, you will now have access to these exclusive Skhook badges!

[h2]👍 Changes 👍[/h2]
Increased Gromato explosion radius by 25% and buffed damage by 50%.
Zombies now take 200% damage from explosives.
Weapon spawners now start fully grown at the start of Horde Mode or when a new weapon is unlocked.
Added outhouse voice sounds.
Added special long distance sound effects for the Sniperagus.
Remove Free For All and Jug-Or-Not from the Random rotation, but they are still in the game to play. These will be added later to a Solos queue. Random will only do team based modes now.
You can now breathe underwater for 10 seconds instead of 3 seconds.
Guns that player drop on death no longer rotate and have simpler physics, to maintain synced on the network.
Gun cursor is now hidden when aiming down sights.
Removed Trailer mode toggle.
Removed 3 achievements that don’t work properly: Love Divers, Sneak Peak, and Over The Fence.

[h2]🛠 Fixes 🛠 [/h2]
Fixed rogue cake in the Church Bell on Graveside.
Fixed getting assists on teammates.
Fixed being able to jump through the bottom of the Oceanside reception tent.
Fixed extra bots on uneven teams.
Fixed switching games modes in the Create Room window resetting your match properties.
Fixed room names being stuck as Tournament Match once you change modes after selecting Tournament mode.
Fixed H20 Delirious mask and Dartboard hat not showing the mohawk hairstyle.
Fixed player showing over and over in Horde Mode scoreboard.
Fixed bow hats showing during camo.
Fixed demon wings wrong color for friendly team members.
Fixed diamond shovel and diamond bok head shaders not working underwater.
Team select screen now works with gamepad.
Fixed Moolotov fire sometimes not spreading.

notes.title: Patch 0.5 - Jumping Bots & Bug Fixes

Welcome farmers new and old! Thank you for continuing to support Shotgun Farmers! As always if you ever have any feedback or ideas, just let me know about them here on Steam or [url=https://discord.gg/j3PrESH]on the Discord![/url]

Here's whats new in this patch:

[h1]Updates[/h1]
[list]
[*]New improvements to AI. They can now jump! They also climb ladders and fall off roofs correctly, instead of zipping up and down. They also have smarter targeting and aiming for the different weapons.
[*]Watch out for the spiky cacti back on Westside!
[*]Weapons now have a minimum distance before fall off damage is applied.
[*]Added LODs to gun and plant models to improve performance.
[*]Chicken will play a different animation if its not on the ground and will float when in water.
[*]New Graveside Church model, with a giant hole in the roof!
[*]Blood fx added when a shot lands.
[*]Default match players is now 6.
[*]Killer’s name shows in HUD when you die.
[*]Longer respawn times during Sudden Death.
[*]Added Leaderboard view to Profile area.
[*]Updated Profile view to show weapon kills.
[*]Carrockets and Tomatoes now go through teleporters.
[*]Spawn base no longer heals you.
[*]No EXP given if you have a score of 0 and 0 kills.
[*]Removed the Axe from Riverside as its way too OP. Removed Axe achievement. (RIP my old friend)
[*]Your badge will now show next to your name in the HUD.
[*]Shotgun shells are now popcorn!
[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed kill alert texts overlapping each other during triple kills.
[*]Fixed gun showing in your hands while you harvest a plant.
[*]Fixed melee weapon sfx not playing when you hit someone.
[*]Fixed AI standing still while trying to shoot.
[*]Fixed AI getting stuck while navigating.
[*]Fixed AI not using Rocket Launchers.
[*]Fixed Main Menu music using wrong volume setting.
[*]Fixed Main Menu animals using wrong volume setting.
[*]Fixed bots not having random skin colors.
[*]Fixed gunshot sfx not working when player dies.
[*]Fixed leaderboard scores not updating correctly.
